name: Revenge Story
source: In a fantasy world where technology is powered by magic, two powerful leagues of superheroes vie for kingdom sovereignty. Unfortunately, the small nations that separate these two giants are the collateral damage of this power war. It is in the wake of one of these tragedies that your character rises from the ashes. Having lost everything, all you have left is revenge... Absolution or total destruction, everything depends on your will!
translation: 在一个科技由魔法驱动的奇幻世界中，两个强大的超级英雄联盟争夺王国主权。不幸的是，分隔这两个巨人的小国是这场权力战争的附带损害。正是在这些悲剧之一之后，你的角色才从灰烬中复活。失去一切，你只剩下复仇……赦免还是彻底毁灭，一切都取决于你的意志！
